page.layout: One page of text, one column; a dedicatory address with a title block at the top, a large woodcut initial at the start of the paragraph, and a signature block at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Reverendissimo Patri in Christo
JONATHANI
Episcopo Exoniensi.

l.i: QUod in publicum commodum hic meditatus
sum, id inprimis grati animi existere volui
erga Te indicium pro iis, quæ tam ubertim

main_text.l: in meconferre dignatus es, meritis. Nec
dubitare me sinit Tuum liberale in iis collocandis inge-
nium, quin candido id accepturus sis animo, quamvis vi-
lis sit nimium eorundem hæc mea recognitio. Res est
utique omnium Christianorum benevolentia digna, quip-
pe ea, quam hic offero, Prophetia, peculiari modo nobis
suggerit mirandam illam Spiritus Sancti effusionem, ex-
actamque gratiarum ac donorum ejus collationem; quæ
temporibus Christi futura erat, atque a S. Petro allega-
tur in ejus adventus promissorumque a Deo præstitorum
argumentum. Nonpaucis hic Propheta difficultatum
implicitus est nodis, quos uti resolvere omni nisu conten-
di, ita, ut conatus meos qualescunque habeas acceptos,
veniaque, si quid cespitatum fuerit, digneris summo pet-
o opere,
Tuæ Reverendiss. Dignitatis
observantissimus
EDUARDUS POCOCKIUS.

page.notes: The woodcut initial Q is joined to "Uod" as "QUod". The red ink stamp at the lower right is a library stamp and is omitted. Some words are doubtful: "meconferre" and "quasi" readings are as printed; "veniaque" and "peto" are as printed. The line "Nonpaucis" is printed as one word.
